name: daily-dial-extension
description: Chrome extension: paint your day on a 24-hour dial and see where the time went.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run check:version && npm run check:package && node scripts/check-locales.mjs && node scripts/check-demo.mjs && node scripts/build-docs-changelog.mjs --check
scripts.package: zip -r daily-dial-v$npm_package_version.zip manifest.json dial.html dial.css dial.js i18n.js lib.js history.js historyLib.js drive.js suggestions.js background.js fonts icons _locales LICENSE -x '.*'
scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir build/firefox
